train_siglip_sd: train a SigLIP projector with Stable Diffusion UNet using distributed data parallel training
create_siglip_encoder: create a SigLIP vision encoder to extract normalized image features with configurable token count
build_projector: build a SimplifiedSigLIPProjector in mlp, xattn, xattnffn, or transformer mode to project vision embeddings
load_models: load pretrained SigLIP encoder, VAE, UNet, and noise scheduler for Stable Diffusion training
save_load_checkpoint: save and load training checkpoints including model state, optimizer, and scheduler state
